تشترعن (form VIII)
# تَشْتَرِعْنَ (taštariʕna) /taʃ.ta.riʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
# تُشْتَرَعْنَ (tuštaraʕna) /tuʃ.ta.raʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
